## E — Market signal: the vision, knowledge and road examinations
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (TN-EXAM-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: the manual publishes a rough topic split for the knowledge test, so a study plan weighted across the four areas is a natural angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: Tennessee learner demand, pass rates, pricing, voice-of-customer quotes and ad hooks for the the vision, knowledge and road examinations topic are unresearched.
